name: Easton Hunter Crocker
source:
Grew up in a relatively traditional family aside from the existence of his bastard half-brother.
He never had a close bond with either of his parents as they were both bigots and he discovered rather young that he was homosexual. He usually is rather calm but is still a sadistic killer. He has a very close bond to his brother, Davis, despite them not being allowed to hang out as children.
